title: Ken-Burns_Pan
slide_intent: Use a restrained pan to reveal a still image over time without breaking its continuity.
strategic_value: A gentle horizontal shift can add life to DB photography while maintaining a calm viewing experience.
demonstration: The employee photograph pans subtly from left to right, with a small rightward arrow at the lower left.
practical_value: Choose a pan when shifting the crop contributes more than changing its scale.

content_islands.name: Image movement
content_islands.spec: Translate the photographic crop slowly along the horizontal axis.

content_islands.name: Direction cue
content_islands.spec: Keep the small rightward arrow at the lower left.

reference_purposes.Expression: The employee photograph pans subtly from left to right, with a small rightward arrow at the lower left.
reference_purposes.Application: The source provides a playable demonstration of this repeatable sequence: The employee photograph pans subtly from left to right, with a small rightward arrow at the lower left.
reference_purposes.Intent: Accompanying Ken-Burns prose explains that slow zooms or pans give still images more dynamism and make content feel more alive.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source specifies smooth, subtle movement with linear easing for the Ken-Burns effect.

ingredient.name: Ken-Burns pan
ingredient.role: Give a still photographic scene continuous movement.
ingredient.application: Use a slow, subtle left-to-right crop translation with linear easing.
